summary.ru: Формулы, случаи употребления, маркеры и типичные ошибки Present Continuous — коротко и по делу.
summary.en: Present Continuous formulas, uses, markers and typical mistakes — short and clear.

body.ru:
(+) am / is / are + V-ing
(–) am / is / are + not + V-ing
(?) Am / Is / Are + V-ing?
body.en:
(+) am / is / are + V-ing
(–) am / is / are + not + V-ing
(?) Am / Is / Are + V-ing?

body.ru:
• действие прямо сейчас
• временная ситуация
• договорённый план на будущее
• изменения и тенденции
body.en:
• an action happening now
• a temporary situation
• a fixed future arrangement
• changes and trends

examples: I am staying with friends this month.
We are meeting at six tomorrow.

body.ru:
• now / right now
• at the moment
• today / this week / these days
• Look! / Listen!
body.en:
• now / right now
• at the moment
• today / this week / these days
• Look! / Listen!

examples: She is talking on the phone now.
They are decorating the flat at the moment.
He is learning to drive these days.

body.ru:
• She is cook dinner → She is cooking dinner
• They is playing → They are playing
• He not working → He is not working
body.en:
• She is cook dinner → She is cooking dinner
• They is playing → They are playing
• He not working → He is not working

questions.sentence: Look! It ___ outside.

explanation.ru: Look! указывает на действие прямо сейчас, подлежащее it требует is + V-ing: is snowing.
explanation.en: Look! points to an action happening right now, and the subject it takes is + V-ing: is snowing.

questions.sentence: They ___ football in the park right now.

translation.ru: Прямо сейчас они играют в футбол в парке.

explanation.ru: Right now — действие в момент речи, с they нужна форма are playing.
explanation.en: Right now signals an action at the moment of speaking; with they we need are playing.

questions.sentence: I ___ for my keys at the moment.

translation.ru: В данный момент я ищу свои ключи.

explanation.ru: At the moment и подлежащее I требуют am + V-ing: am looking.
explanation.en: At the moment and the subject I require am + V-ing: am looking.

questions.sentence: She ___ a book about space these days.

translation.ru: В последнее время она читает книгу о космосе.

explanation.ru: These days — временная ситуация вокруг настоящего, с she нужна форма is reading.
explanation.en: These days signals a temporary situation around now; with she we need is reading.

questions.sentence: Listen! Somebody ___ at the door.

explanation.ru: Listen! вводит действие, происходящее сейчас; somebody требует is knocking.
explanation.en: Listen! introduces an action happening now; somebody takes is knocking.

questions.sentence: We ___ dinner now, so call back later.

translation.ru: Сейчас мы ужинаем, так что перезвони позже.

explanation.ru: Now — действие в момент речи, с we нужна форма are having.
explanation.en: Now signals an action at the moment of speaking; with we we need are having.

questions.sentence: He ___ to work this week because his car is broken.

translation.ru: На этой неделе он ходит на работу пешком, потому что его машина сломана.

explanation.ru: This week — временная ситуация, поэтому Present Continuous: is walking.
explanation.en: This week signals a temporary situation, so Present Continuous is used: is walking.

questions.sentence: My parents ___ a new house at the moment.

translation.ru: В данный момент мои родители строят новый дом.

explanation.ru: At the moment и подлежащее my parents требуют are building.
explanation.en: At the moment and the subject my parents require are building.

questions.sentence: What ___ you doing?

explanation.ru: Вопрос в Present Continuous: What are you doing? Нужна форма are.
explanation.en: A Present Continuous question: What are you doing? The form are is needed.

questions.sentence: ___ she working today?

explanation.ru: Вопрос в Present Continuous начинается с формы be: Is she working?
explanation.en: A Present Continuous question begins with the form of be: Is she working?

questions.sentence: They ___ watching a film.

explanation.ru: Отрицание в Present Continuous: are not + V-ing с подлежащим they.
explanation.en: The Present Continuous negative: are not + V-ing with the subject they.

questions.sentence: She is ___ a cake for the party.

explanation.ru: При добавлении -ing конечная e выпадает: make → making.
explanation.en: When -ing is added, a final e is dropped: make → making.

questions.sentence: The dog is ___ after the ball.

explanation.ru: Короткая конечная согласная после гласной удваивается: run → running.
explanation.en: A short final consonant after a vowel doubles: run → running.

questions.sentence: He is ___ for the bus at the stop.

explanation.ru: Wait → waiting: конечная t не удваивается, потому что ударение падает на первый слог.
explanation.en: Wait → waiting: the final t does not double because the stress is on the first syllable.

questions.sentence: I ___ the answer to this question.

translation.ru: Я знаю ответ на этот вопрос.

explanation.ru: Know — глагол состояния, он не употребляется в длительной форме: I know.
explanation.en: Know is a state verb and is not used in the continuous form: I know.

questions.sentence: She ___ to visit her grandmother.

explanation.ru: Want — глагол состояния; с подлежащим she нужна простая форма wants.
explanation.en: Want is a state verb; with the subject she the simple form wants is used.

questions.sentence: She usually ___ to school, but today she is walking.

translation.ru: Обычно она ходит в школу пешком, но сегодня идёт пешком.

explanation.ru: Usually указывает на привычку, поэтому нужен Present Simple: walks. Вторая часть с today — временная ситуация.
explanation.en: Usually signals a habit, so Present Simple is used: walks. The second part with today describes a temporary situation.

questions.sentence: At the moment, the children ___ in the garden.

translation.ru: В данный момент дети играют в саду.

explanation.ru: At the moment — действие сейчас, с the children нужна форма are playing.
explanation.en: At the moment signals an action now; with the children we need are playing.

questions.sentence: My brother ___ for his exams this month.

translation.ru: В этом месяце мой брат готовится к экзаменам.

explanation.ru: This month — временный период, поэтому Present Continuous: is studying.
explanation.en: This month signals a temporary period, so Present Continuous is used: is studying.

questions.sentence: Do not disturb him — he ___ a report.

translation.ru: Не мешай ему — он пишет отчёт.

explanation.ru: Действие происходит прямо сейчас, подлежащее he требует is writing.
explanation.en: The action is happening right now, and the subject he requires is writing.

explanation.ru: Present Continuous: are + V-ing; действие происходит сейчас.
explanation.en: Present Continuous: are + V-ing; the action is happening now.

explanation.ru: Отрицание в Present Continuous: is not + V-ing.
explanation.en: The Present Continuous negative: is not + V-ing.

explanation.ru: Вопрос в Present Continuous: Are + подлежащее + V-ing.
explanation.en: A Present Continuous question: Are + subject + V-ing.

translation.ru: На этой неделе я работаю из дома.

explanation.ru: This week — временная ситуация, поэтому Present Continuous: am working.
explanation.en: This week signals a temporary situation, so Present Continuous is used: am working.

explanation.ru: Удвоение конечной согласной: run → running.
explanation.en: The final consonant doubles: run → running.
